summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. III (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting its domestication from Cayman Islands to British Columbia, completed July 27, 2026, in anticipation of closing its business combination with Tactical Resources Corp. The filing details the continuation under Cayman and BC law, with each existing Class A share, warrant, and unit becoming registered securities of Canadian Plum. This is a structural step toward the merger, with no deal terms specified. The registration and de-registration were concurrent; the merger awaits closing, so the risk-arb angle is the deal's completion and any regulatory approvals.
